# Ensemble

A multiplayer, collaborative sandbox building game made with Godot 4, C#, and .NET.

![](/Assets/Images/EnsembleIconSquareColored.png "Ensemble Icon")

> [!NOTE]
> - This game is the direct successor to [Baja Builders](https://www.roblox.com/games/85484945236913) on Roblox.
> - Code quality may be "sub-par" while the codebase continues to mature.
